entities.name: ACC synaptic transmission and plasticity genes

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: identified four genes for mRNA and protein with trends that were concordantly decreasing, including glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase 1, mitochondrial (Gpam), XK-related protein 4 (Xkr4), NIPA-like domain-containing 3 (Nipal3), and homeodomain-interacting protein kinase 3 (Hipk3)

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The DEPs were mainly involved in mitophagy, spliceosome, autophagy, and peroxisome.

key_findings: SNI yields 788 DEGs (mostly synaptic) and 222 DEPs (autophagy, mitophagy, peroxisome) in rat ACC.
Only Nipal3, Hipk3 and Xkr4 show concordant, correlated mRNA and protein decreases.
